section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces the Kaufman Domains of Creativity Scale (K-DOCS), a self-report measure for domain-specific creativity across five domains: Everyday, Scholarly, Performance, Science, and the Arts. The current study aims to validate the K-DOCS' factor structure using the Amusement Park Theoretical hierarchical model. It utilized two distinct samples: one from Amazon Mechanical Turk (N = 825) and another from Poland (N = 500), with the Polish sample also completing additional creativity measures like the CAQ and intelligence measures.
